boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten complimentary ways for HPU students—and, where noted, the public—to share movies, art, games, and recreation without admission or a required purchase.

cards.title: Catch a Campus Movie
cards.subtitle: Complimentary screenings inside the R.G. Wanek Center
cards.notes: Bring a valid HPU Passport, check the current screening schedule, and meet friends downstairs in the Wanek Center before showtime.
cards.short_summary: Weekly films pair a theater outing with included concessions and occasional interactive ScreenPlay games.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU states that students can attend weekly movie showings at the Bertram L. Podell Extraordinaire Cinema complimentary with a valid HPU Passport.
cards.access_notes: For HPU students with a valid HPU Passport; consult the current schedule because showtimes change and screenings must be university-licensed.

cards.title: Start an Arcade Matchup
cards.subtitle: Console, pinball, billiards, and simulator play in Wanek
cards.notes: Bring your HPU Passport to check out equipment, then choose a multiplayer console, billiards table, pinball game, or sports simulator.
cards.short_summary: A campus-card checkout unlocks several group-friendly games without buying tokens or equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU says students can check out video games, consoles, and other arcade equipment free of charge at The Point Arcade.
cards.access_notes: For HPU students; an HPU Passport is required to check out gaming supplies. The arcade closes during academic breaks.

cards.title: Walk Through a Gallery Show
cards.subtitle: Public exhibitions in the Hayworth Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, enter through the University Parkway gate, and spend a weekday afternoon discussing the current show.
cards.short_summary: Rotating regional, national, and permanent-collection exhibitions offer a no-ticket cultural meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery states that all exhibitions, gallery talks, and openings are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. The gallery follows HPU's academic calendar; verify the date before arriving and use the University Parkway gate.

cards.title: Join an Intramural Game
cards.subtitle: Team and individual recreation through HPU REC
cards.notes: Create an IMLeagues account with your HPU email, then join a team, form one with friends, or list yourself as a free agent.
cards.short_summary: Competitive and noncompetitive leagues turn a free afternoon into an organized campus matchup.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU REC identifies intramural sports as one of its services and states that all recreation services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Current sports and divisions require registration through the HPU REC app or IMLeagues with an HPU email.

cards.title: Take a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Student-led sessions in Slane and Panther Commons
cards.notes: Open IMLeagues 24 hours before class, choose a shared Yoga, Pilates, HIIT, Spin, or Barre session, and reserve your place.
cards.short_summary: More than 60 weekly classes provide a structured, social workout across two campus facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU lists Group Exercise among Recreation Services, states that classes meet in Slane Student Center and Panther Commons, and says all recreation services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Class sign-up is handled through IMLeagues; registration opens 24 hours before the class starts.

cards.title: Organize Outdoor Laser Tag
cards.subtitle: Team play through HPU Recreation Services
cards.notes: Invite a group, confirm current availability with HPU REC, and wear active clothing suitable for moving around the outdoor course.
cards.short_summary: The dedicated outdoor facility offers a team-based alternative to indoor gaming.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services lists an Outdoor Laser Tag facility among its recreational offerings and states that all services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Contact HPU REC to confirm current access, equipment procedures, and any reservation requirement.

cards.title: Meet for an Open Swim
cards.subtitle: Indoor and heated outdoor pools on campus
cards.notes: Check the current open-swim schedule, choose an operating pool, and bring swimwear and a towel for laps or a relaxed poolside meetup.
cards.short_summary: HPU's indoor and outdoor pools support both lap swimming and low-key recreational time.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services advertises open swimming through HPU Aquatics and states that all recreation services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Use only during posted open-swim periods and follow current aquatics and facility rules.

cards.title: Set Up Beach Volleyball
cards.subtitle: Casual outdoor play on four campus courts
cards.notes: Gather enough players for a casual rotation, bring water, and check court availability with HPU REC before heading outside.
cards.short_summary: Four dedicated sand courts make it easy to scale a meetup from a small rally to team play.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services lists four beach volleyball courts for friendly competition and casual play and states that all services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Outdoor access can depend on weather, programming, and court availability; confirm current conditions with HPU REC.

cards.title: Run an Outdoor Basketball Game
cards.subtitle: Pickup play across three campus courts
cards.notes: Bring a group for HORSE, shooting drills, or a pickup game, and check that a court is open before planning the meetup.
cards.short_summary: Three outdoor courts support anything from a two-person shootaround to a larger pickup rotation.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services lists three outdoor basketball courts for friendly competition and casual play and states that all services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Outdoor access can depend on weather, campus programming, and court availability.

cards.title: Play a Round of Croquet
cards.subtitle: Laid-back outdoor recreation through HPU REC
cards.notes: Ask HPU REC where to collect the equipment and play, then invite a small group for an easygoing lawn-game session between classes.
cards.short_summary: Croquet offers a slower-paced group activity that does not require participants to own a set.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services lists Croquet among its outdoor leisure activities and states that all recreation services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary for HPU students. Confirm the current equipment checkout process, play location, and weather conditions with HPU REC.
